scope: optional private S3-compatible report artifact adapter, including Cloudflare R2 configuration support

checks.static_worker_inventories: passed; seven reports regenerated and current

contract: local private artifact storage remains the default
S3-compatible provider uses explicit endpoint, bucket, region and UUID-only object prefix
Gateway receives separate read-only credentials; worker receives separate write/delete credentials
S3 reads require a bound and close the body on success or failure
provider exceptions and object paths are redacted from safe errors
S3 dependency import is lazy and remains in the optional exports dependency group
